narratives.Description: Add fresh-clone Deft recovery to README
narratives.Overview: Problem: README.md only contains the project title while .deft/core/ is gitignored, so AGENTS.md's cold-start route is unreachable on a fresh clone. Acceptance: add the sanctioned deft:cold-start-bootstrap v1 global-first ladder at the top of README.md, keep recovery independent of .deft/core/, and pass Deft validation plus CI. Found during independent review of PR #1.
